name: C21 activiti:potentialStarter
description: user(carl), user( dora ), group(auditors) and a bare reviewers become candidate starters of the process definition (asserted in model-expect.json), but nothing is restricted: the element does not mark the starters as defined, so the Spring Boot deployment also adds the group * (everyone) and every user can start (engine finding C21.1). The restricting case is starter-sources.

scenarios.name: a listed user starts the process and is the initiator
a member of a listed group starts the process
a user who is in no list starts it too, through the everyone group
so does a member of an unrelated group
